questions.statement: ________ the flag, the soldiers advanced toward the city gates.
questions.context: Describing two simultaneous actions in a historical battle.

options.feedback: Correct! Present participle clause (-ing) shows two actions happening at the same time by the same subject.
Incorrect. Past participle has a passive meaning.
Incorrect. This would mean they carried it before they advanced.
Incorrect. Infinitives don't function as participle clauses here.

questions.explanation:
Las oraciones de participio de presente (*-ing*) se usan para describir dos acciones que el mismo sujeto realiza de manera simultánea.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: The treaty, ________ by both leaders, finally brought peace to the region.
questions.context: Describing a result of a past event.

options.feedback: Incorrect. This would mean the treaty was doing the signing.
Correct! Past participle clause has a passive meaning, like a reduced relative clause.
Incorrect. Refers to an action in progress.

questions.explanation:
El participio pasado (*signed*) funciona aquí como una oración de relativo reducida ("which was signed").

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: ________ the election, the new president began his social reforms immediately.

options.feedback: Incorrect. This implies he was winning at the same time he started the reforms.
Correct! Perfect participle clause (having + past participle) shows one action finished before another.
Incorrect. Infinitives don't show this sequence.

questions.explanation:
Usamos el participio de perfecto (*Having won*) para dejar claro que una acción terminó completamente antes de que comenzara la siguiente acción en el pasado.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: ________ that the situation was dangerous, the explorers decided to return to the coast.
questions.context: Explaining a reason for a past event.

options.feedback: Correct! Present participle can show a cause or reason.
Incorrect. While possible, "Realizing" fits the immediate cause better.

questions.explanation:
Una oración de participio de presente puede usarse para explicar la razón de la acción principal. Equivale a decir "Because they realized...".

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: There are several documents in the archive ________ the history of the independence.
questions.context: Describing the content of a document.

options.feedback: Incorrect. This would mean the documents were described by something else.
Correct! Present participle functions like an active relative clause ("which describe").
Incorrect. Too complex for this context.

questions.explanation:
El participio de presente se usa frecuentemente para sustituir oraciones de relativo activas.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: ________ at the foot of the mountains, the town was isolated from most trade routes.

options.feedback: Correct! Past participle shows the passive state or situation.

questions.explanation:
Usamos el participio pasado al inicio de la oración para describir una circunstancia o estado pasivo del sujeto principal.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.context: Identifying the correct subject of a participle clause.

options.text: Walking through the museum, the paintings were beautiful.
options.feedback: Incorrect. This implies the paintings were walking.

options.text: Walking through the museum, I saw many beautiful paintings.
options.feedback: Correct! The subject "I" is the one who was walking.

options.text: Walked through the museum, I saw many paintings.
Having walking through the museum, I saw many paintings.

questions.explanation:
El sujeto de la oración principal debe ser el mismo que realiza la acción expresada por el participio.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement:
"Having finished the report, the researcher submitted it to the academy."
What does this imply?
questions.context: Understanding the nuance of the perfect participle.

options.text: He submitted it while he was finishing it.
He submitted it only after he had completely finished it.
options.feedback: Correct! "Having + past participle" emphasizes completion of the first action.

options.text: He finished it because he submitted it.
He submitted it to help him finish it.

questions.explanation:
El participio de perfecto (*Having finished*) indica prioridad temporal entre dos acciones pasadas.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: ________ enough evidence to prove his theory, the scientist continued his research for years.

options.feedback: Correct! Negative participle clauses start with "Not" followed by the participle.

questions.explanation:
Para formar la versión negativa de una oración de participio, colocamos *not* delante del participio.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement:
Identify the error in this paragraph:
"Growing up during the industrial revolution, the city changed rapidly. Built near the coal mines, the factories polluted the air. Having been successful in business, the owners **becoming** very wealthy."
questions.context: Finding an error in a historical summary.

options.feedback: Correct! This should be a finite verb (became) because it is the main verb of the sentence.

questions.explanation:
Una oración de participio no puede funcionar como el verbo principal de una oración independiente.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which sentence is the most formal way to report a historical event?
questions.context: Choosing the best way to report an event.

options.text: The king was defeated and then he went into exile.
When the king was defeated, he went into exile.
Defeated in battle, the king went into exile.
options.feedback: Correct! Uses a past participle clause for conciseness.

options.text: The king, who was defeated, went into exile.

questions.explanation:
El uso de oraciones de participio es una característica del lenguaje académico e histórico formal.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: "Understanding the discovery, the explorers sent a messenger, ________ for more supplies."

options.feedback: Correct! Present participle for simultaneous action.

questions.explanation: El uso de participios permite crear una narrativa histórica fluida y de nivel avanzado.
